scope: Independent RAW figure-29 review, original51/printed41; D269 source prose separate.

png.basis: All six circuits and both springs match source inventory. RGB pixels equal original crop [258,1295,1291,1853] exactly: zero changed pixels.

svg.basis: Existing frozen preview preserves instructional topology, polarity, labels, arrows, dash-dot baselines, mass levels, small marks and subdivisions. No blocking contour change observed.

Filled support, longer zigzag spring, round mass centered on dash-dot equilibrium line, equilibrium text below, v-shaped/M-like label and small overhead right-directed vector mark.

Striped support, shorter zigzag spring, round mass above equilibrium; dash-dot baseline and text; right-side downward heads, small velocity/displacement glyph shapes, two horizontal levels and long vertical extension.

Both source quarter-period headings and a-shaped/b-like subdivision marks retained. Caption lies below image boundary and is present once as the separate page kind=cap block labelled figure29; printed-page footer and preceding prose excluded.

findings.detail: 1033x558 rawPNG is a byte-value-exact RGB subimage of original51; no lost or added ink within its source rectangle. Caption exclusion is intentional separation, verified in frozen page metadata, not an unexplained crop loss.

Preview smooths ragged scan edges and rounds/thickens some small strokes. Four downward current heads, charge-row polarities, plate gaps, four-lobe coils, support stripe separations and dash-dot baseline gaps remain visually recognizable.

A few isolated specks persist from the original scan; no neighboring paragraph, equation, caption duplication or page footer contaminates either candidate. Both candidates retain full circuit/spring extremities and subdivision marks with margin.

previewDarkMask.meaning: Contour diagnostic only, not a semantic pass criterion.

limitations: Scan resolution limits small glyph/subscript decoding and exact outermost full-charge sign multiplicity. Visible shapes, positions, polarity and direction are the fidelity criterion; encoded Latin/Cyrillic identity is not demanded from raster pixels.
Lower-spring overlapping velocity/displacement marks are preserved as source shapes and levels, not independently decoded into a complete formula.

SVG was judged through the existing frozen preview only. Freeze binds current SVG, preview and successful receipt; the receipt contains paths and exitCode=0 but no embedded byte-at-render hashes. Historical render-time byte identity cannot be established beyond those frozen bindings.
Vector contour smoothing is not pixel identity. The overlap measurement supports contour inspection but cannot by itself prove label or topology fidelity.
No source-prose/D269 judgment, modern-edition readability/cultural/scientific gate, product-view test, course completion or publication approval is supplied.
